_comment: Reviews and rating from the TripAdvisor listing. Only reviews with featured:true render in the carousel; the rest are kept here so they can be swapped in without retyping. `rating` feeds the trust strip, the 'Read all N reviews' link and the JSON-LD aggregateRating.

reviews.title: An Authentic Kerala Experience to Remember
reviews.text: A peaceful stay in an 80+ year old traditional Tharavadu, hosted by warm, inspiring Shyamala Ma'am. Every meal was freshly prepared authentic Malabar cuisine and was the highlight of the trip.
reviews.name: Yuvaraj

reviews.title: Where Every Meal Feels Like Home
reviews.text: Felt like joining a family from the moment of arrival, thanks to Shyamala Madam's warmth. Her home-cooked Malabar dishes, from fresh fish curry to kappa made with local, organic ingredients, were the real highlight.
reviews.name: Odyssey04998055244

reviews.title: Hospitality at the Max with Authentic Malabar Food
reviews.text: One night here felt like visiting family, with the kids greeted with mango pudding on arrival. Though Shyamala aunty is vegetarian herself, she cooked a full non-veg Malabar spread including fish cutlets and fish curry beautifully.
reviews.name: Tharani T

reviews.title: Its Like Visiting Your Parents' Place with all the Love and Amazing Food
reviews.text: Three nights in a 200-year-old home with modern comforts, hosted by a caring, resourceful aunty who arranged a boat ride and a local Theyyam performance. Meals were eaten together like family, full of laughter.
reviews.name: Preeti Kothari

reviews.title: Great Hospitality & Culinary Delights
reviews.text: A short but memorable stay surrounded by palm groves, with spotless, recently modernized rooms. Mrs. Nair even whipped up a special butter chicken on request alongside her usual home cooking.
reviews.name: Sightseer35908895304

reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text: A lovely visit with great home-style vegetarian food and engaging conversation with the host. Also got to see the nearby hanging bridge and part of a local Theyyam performance.
reviews.name: sjagadish
